_doc: The scripted captain meets freighters in the campaign as the concord (openspec/changes/freighter-missions, tasks 2.7 and 3.4; owner, 2026-11-07: "Just whenever you are on the same tile as freighter, you get a mission option", "capturing enemy freighter: bring it to a station to cash out"): a new campaign, the fleet sailed into another faction's freighter's sector and her Raid key pressed, the raid fought out, any cargo taken cashed out at a port that buys it, then the fleet sailed to one of its own freighters and her Escort played. It saves to user://campaign-playtest-concord.json, never over the player's campaign. In a window, snap saves stills into docs/screenshots/game/freighters-concord/.
